comment: The implementations of orm, the one source of its language set, and the shared vector suites and the error catalog that each of them holds, as the tree stands. The parity tool of @polyspec/kit reads it (make parity-declarations-check, make parity-check; docs/tool-inventory of kit, Language parity). A missing binding stays missing so that the check reports it.

profiles.name: ts-internal
profiles.reason: An implementation-internal test checks the structure of the TypeScript implementation itself; the contract has no counterpart for it.

profiles.name: go-internal
profiles.reason: An implementation-internal test checks the structure of its own implementation; the contract has no counterpart for it.

profiles.name: client
profiles.reason: The PHP extension orm_dbspec implements only the dbspec surface of the PHP client (Polyspec\Orm\Dbspec\Native): it has no query client, codec, DSN, statement events or error codes.

profiles.name: rust-internal
profiles.reason: Each test here checks the structure of the Rust implementation itself: its planner, codecs, build tool and schema modules. The shared interface has no counterpart for them, so the profile holds the rust implementation only.

profiles.name: python-internal
profiles.reason: The Python tests of the implementation's own structure: its harness, packaging, installation, driver adapters and helpers. They check code that implements no shared vector or interface, so no other implementation has a counterpart and only python binds them.

profiles.name: python-feature
profiles.reason: The Python owner of a feature coverage program: each test method runs one case of the feature on every database item of its file. The other languages' owners of the same feature are native tests of their own, so this profile holds the Python owner alone.

profiles.name: php-internal
profiles.reason: An implementation-internal test checks the structure of the PHP implementation; the contract has no counterpart for it.

profiles.name: php-extension-internal
profiles.reason: An implementation-internal test of the PHP extension orm_dbspec: it checks the extension's own cleanup after a failing PDO, its name rendering, its apply path and the agreement of its class declarations with the PHP client and the stub. The shared dbspec suites bind the results these tests reach; no other implementation has a counterpart for these methods.

profiles.name: set-consumers
profiles.reason: The two clients whose tests run over the document sets of contracts/fixtures: the PHP and TypeScript tests generate or load the decimal and bench documents through their set. Go and Rust read their own copies of the decimal manifest, and Python generates the bench models in make, with no test over the set.

tools.reason: Benchmarks that measure the performance of the Go implementation; they implement no contract and run only under go test -bench, so they belong to no implementation.
Analyzers for the Go test conventions of the repository; the tooling implements no contract, so its tests belong to no implementation.
The PHP generator of tests/codec/vectors.json, which the codec suites read; the generator is single-language tooling that implements no contract.
The CodeMirror adapter of the dbspec editor stack: JavaScript over @polyspec/dbspec-language, with no grammar and no contract of its own.
The dbspec language service of the editor stack: diagnostics, tokens, folding and formatting over the parser of the TypeScript runtime; it implements no contract of its own.
The dbspec language server of the editor stack, which serves every editor over @polyspec/dbspec-language; it implements no contract of its own.
The VS Code extension of the editor stack: its manifest and bundle, which hold no grammar and implement no contract.
The repository scripts: the tooling of the checks, builds, installs and releases; it implements no contract, so its tests belong to no implementation.
The test of the command-line install of dbspec-fmt: the editor-stack tooling, which implements no contract.
The test of the dbs fence of the documentation site: the tooling of the site, which implements no contract.
The test of the timing harness of the clients: the measurement tooling, which implements no contract.

bindings.id: the subpath module reaches no Node module, undeclared package or Node global
every apply scenario runs on its dialects
every plan case runs on every dialect
plan steps reject an unknown dialect
set-files parseSet takes a Uint8Array and a string
dbspec stress document parses and emits canonically
every code point is classified by the ranges of the table
manifest rejects a repeated document name
sqlite: connect takes the DSN and options without a schema path
the models script scans exactly the sources that call models
syntax.json is what the generator writes from the current cases
IN lists of lengths 1 to 300 share at most ten plan cache keys
an IN list pads to its bucket by repeating its last value and renumbers its parameters
a parameter index past the parameters is IR_INVALID
